query: I just got back from picking up my new rescue kitten this afternoon, she’s the cutest little tabby with white paws and she immediately curled up on my lap when I brought her home. I stopped to grab a matcha latte on the way too, and the barista drew a little cat face in the foam that I almost didn’t want to drink. I was planning to call my sister to tell her all about the kitten as soon as I got home, but my phone isn’t working at all right now. Airplane mode is turned on, my line is suspended because I have an overdue bill and my contract just ended, my SIM card is locked with a PIN, and I think the SIM card might be unseated too, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
